name: Securities Balance Transparency Report Status Advice V 01
definition: SCOPE||An account owner, such as a custodian, central securities depository, international securities depository or transfer agent, sends the SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReportStatusAdvice message in response to a SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReport, to accept or reject the statement of holdings as sent in a SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReport.||USAGE|The SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReportStatusAdvice is used to accept (Accepted), partially accept (Accepted With Exception) or reject (Rejected) a previously received SecuritiesBalanceTransparencyReport.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the status advice message.

SenderIdentification.name: Sender Identification
SenderIdentification.definition: Identification of the party that is the sender of the status advice message.

ReceiverIdentification.name: Receiver Identification
ReceiverIdentification.definition: Identification of the party that is the receiver of the status advice message.

RelatedStatement.name: Related Statement
RelatedStatement.definition: Reference of the statement for which the status advice has been issued.

NumberOfItemsPerStatus.name: Number Of Items Per Status
NumberOfItemsPerStatus.definition: Number of items for each identical transaction status.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
